7ce7491d0fae94b86f6ac4cc567a565c.name: NASA SMAP/MSL Spacecraft Anomaly Dataset
7ce7491d0fae94b86f6ac4cc567a565c.description: 55-channel SMAP (Soil Moisture Active Passive) satellite telemetry and 27-channel MSL (Mars Science Lab / Curiosity) rover telemetry with expert-labeled anomaly spans. Canonical benchmark from Hundman et al. SIGKDD 2018.

7ce7491d0fae94b86f6ac4cc567a565c.name: TESS Exoplanet Transit Light Curves
7ce7491d0fae94b86f6ac4cc567a565c.description: Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS) photometric time-series. 2-minute cadence flux measurements for hundreds of thousands of stars with confirmed exoplanet transit labels from NASA ExoFOP catalog.
7ce7491d0fae94b86f6ac4cc567a565c.label_type: transit event spans + planet confirmation flag

7ce7491d0fae94b86f6ac4cc567a565c.name: GOES X-ray Solar Flare Flux
7ce7491d0fae94b86f6ac4cc567a565c.description: GOES satellite 1-minute X-ray flux (0.05-0.4 nm and 0.1-0.8 nm bands) from 1986 to present with NOAA-classified solar flare events (A/B/C/M/X class + peak time). Different from ts-gym spaceweather corpus (which uses Kp/sunspot/F10.7).

7ce7491d0fae94b86f6ac4cc567a565c.name: ESA Anomaly Detection Benchmark (SKAB - Space-adjacent)
7ce7491d0fae94b86f6ac4cc567a565c.description: Skoltech Anomaly Benchmark: 34 labeled multivariate time-series files from a real testbed (waterflow pipeline sensors). Used as a proxy for spacecraft fluid system anomaly detection. All files have anomaly timestamps + anomaly type labels.

eab73a4f7401260b353e83d01a3b60d6.name: TESS Exoplanet Transit Light Curves
eab73a4f7401260b353e83d01a3b60d6.description: Transiting Exoplanet Survey Satellite (TESS) photometric time-series. 2-minute cadence flux measurements for hundreds of thousands of stars with confirmed exoplanet transit labels from NASA ExoFOP catalog.
eab73a4f7401260b353e83d01a3b60d6.label_type: transit event spans + planet confirmation flag

eab73a4f7401260b353e83d01a3b60d6.name: GOES X-ray Solar Flare Flux

eab73a4f7401260b353e83d01a3b60d6.name: NASA C-MAPSS Turbofan Run-to-Failure (FD003/FD004)
eab73a4f7401260b353e83d01a3b60d6.description: Extended C-MAPSS dataset with two-fault-condition turbofan fleets (FD003/FD004). 21 sensor channels per flight cycle, remaining-useful-life ground truth. NOTE: Base C-MAPSS (cmapss) is in ts-gym; FD003/FD004 with dual faults are the distinct harder variants used in aerospace prognostics.

eab73a4f7401260b353e83d01a3b60d6.name: GAIA DR3 Stellar Variability Light Curves
eab73a4f7401260b353e83d01a3b60d6.description: ESA GAIA Data Release 3: epoch photometry for ~10M variable stars, G/BP/RP bands, variability class labels (Cepheid, RR Lyrae, eclipsing binary, etc). Distinct from ts-gym ASAS-SN (V-band) and ZTF (g/r-band).
